sloka: अयोध्या अधिपते वीर शापात् चण्डालताम् गतः ।अथ तत् वाक्यम् आकर्ण्य राजा चण्डालताम् गतः ॥१-५८-१६॥
transliteration: ayodhyā adhipate vīra śāpāt caṇḍālatām gataḥ ।atha tat vākyam ākarṇya rājā caṇḍālatām gataḥ ॥1-58-16॥

translations.english: The king, having approached all the illustrious sons of his spiritual guide, paid obeisance to them in order of seniority. Bowing down his face in humility and with folded palms, he addressed all those distinguished sons of Vasishta saying:
